statement: For a in [19/50,2/5] with first(a)=second(a), and q in [0,sqrt(2)-1], max(first(a),second(a)) <= max(first(q),second(q)).
proof_method: For q>=a: exact factored F1 difference and positive denominators. For q<=a: exact integer Bernstein certificate for F2 difference on [0,2/5]^2 and sqrt(2) in [7/5,3/2].
limitations: This is an exact conditional minimax theorem for the two stated algebraic support functions.
Existence and identification of the crossing angle are proved in a separate module.
Applying the result to packings requires independently proved support inequalities; no global support-branch coverage theorem is provided here.
